Scary Hospital Horror Game
Scary Hospital Horror Game is an addictive first-person survival 3D horror and Escape game 

Scary Hospital Horror Game is now available on Steam! There's a 30% discount during launch week to say thanks to anyone who is lovely enough to pick it up:
	 A brand new Indie Game Company The Next Generation Gaming introduces its Second Pc title ' Scary Hospital Horror Game' addictive first-person survival horror game 

	Scary Hospital Horror is a survival horror and Escape game designed for Pc. The Story based on a Scary haunted hospital. Henry Working for a private newspaper company. This company sends too many reporters to investigate and get information about this haunted hospital but on one comeback from this hospital.
now I decided to get information about his haunted hospital. a few days ago I started the search in this hospital. this hospital is haunted and only Freddy was escaped from this hospital.
	The Powerful Unreal Engine 4 Create Amazing 3D High-End Graphics with Interesting Game Play and Stunning Haunted Horror Atmosphere.
